$comment: The Ambassador page on the role template. Its copy comes from the program page (content/site/join.json); keep the two in step.
description: Help the right people find The Upskilling Labs, one conversation at a time. Free, and yours to shape.

title: Share a good thing.
hero.alt: The Ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR

intro.lede: Work is changing faster than anyone can keep up alone. The Upskilling Labs is a community where we learn and adapt together. As ambassadors, we help folks who'd love it discover it, one conversation at a time.
intro.terms: A few conversations and one talk.

items.title: Start a conversation.
items.body: Ask someone what they're curious about, and really listen. Over time, bring [N] people to their first workshop.

items.title: Take the mic.
items.body: Give one short talk to a group you're part of. We'll help you practice first.

items.title: Welcome the next ambassador.
items.body: Help someone new find their way in, the way someone once did for you.

items.title: Ten minutes to join.
items.body: Then half an hour with the guide before your first conversation.

items.title: No pitch. No script.
items.body: Your own story, and a question about theirs.

items.title: Never on your own.
items.body: Your coordinator, a local volunteer lead, is with you the whole way.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Being an ambassador costs nothing, and neither does anything at The Labs.

path.title: You start by listening. You end up leading.

steps.title: Raise your hand.
steps.body: Let us know you're interested. That's the whole first step.

steps.title: Join in.
steps.body: About ten minutes on your phone. Your coordinator gives you your Ambassador button.

steps.title: Listen first.
steps.body: Half an hour with the guide, then your first conversations. Ask, listen, and bring back what you hear.

steps.title: Then lead.
steps.body: Give your talk, and welcome the next ambassador. Finish the path, and your button gets a brass rim.

button.title: How ambassadors know each other.
button.body: Given to you in person by your coordinator when you join. Wear it to the events you bring people to.
button.rim: Finish the path, and a brass rim goes around it: Ambassador, practised.

items.a: No. Being an ambassador is free, and so is every program at The Labs. Supporting membership is the only thing with dues, and it's optional.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: About ten minutes to join and half an hour to get ready. After that, it's mostly conversations you'd have anyway, plus one talk.

items.q: Do I have to sell anything?
items.a: Not at all. There's nothing for sale. Just share your story and point people to theupskillinglabs.org.
Yes, any time. You're always welcome back.

join.title: Come be an ambassador.
join.lede: Think of who might be next. It takes about ten minutes to join, and we'll figure out the rest together.
